newsitem.title: USA: FGIC names Wright Benner to government affairs.
newsitem.headline: FGIC names Wright Benner to government affairs.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co, a unit of GE Capital Services, said Tuesday it named Mary Wright Benner manager of government affairs.
In her new post, Wright Benner will be responsible for developing and implementing legislative strategies for FGIC's bond insurance and government services businesses.
She will also be FGIC's principal liaison to Washington and state governments, and manage the company's relationships with trade associations.
Wright Benner joined FGIC in 1986, and most recently held the position of marketing manager of FGIC Public Sourcing Services, Inc.
GE Capital is a unit of General Electric Co..
